youtube_short.title: Your Raise Is Secretly a Pay Cut
title_alternatives: The Raise Lie Your Boss Never Tells You
How Inflation Quietly Eats Your Raise Alive
youtube_short.description: You got a raise and celebrated — but here's the math nobody runs for you. In 2022, average raises were 5%. Inflation hit 7.9%. That gap quietly drained $2,700 from a $70K salary in a single year. Run it over 10 years and the difference between your nominal wage and your real buying power reaches $18,000. And here's the wild part: HR departments set raise budgets using the exact same inflation data. They know the gap. They're counting on you not doing the math. Next time you negotiate, don't just ask for a raise — ask for CPI plus your actual productivity gains. Follow for daily money psychology. #finance #salary #inflation #personalfinance #money

hook_line: Your raise is secretly a pay cut
